metadata.description: Agent Doorbell's Claude Code plugin. Unofficial; not affiliated with Slack or Anthropic.

plugins.name: agent-doorbell
plugins.description: Lets Claude Code agents handle Slack messages queued by Agent Doorbell: setup, handle, listen and status skills, plus hooks that ack items after a Slack reply. Needs the doorbell command (pipx install agent-doorbell). Unofficial; not affiliated with Slack or Anthropic.
